name: shotcrew
description: A four-role video team that turns existing footage, product shots and screenshots into review-safe Chinese brand short videos, delivered in both 16:9 and 9:16.

profession.zh: 工业化AI短视频制片团队

displayDescription.en:
We make AI video look like it came from a real production crew, not a blind box. We treat the four fatal flaws of AI editing, plus two services others decline: (1) Review risk - a built-in 117-term ad-law dictionary pins down prohibited superlatives and medical claims first, then catches unsupported bragging, so violations are stopped before launch. (2) Continuity breaks - four-way locking (person, props, set lighting, global color grade): no face swapping between shots, no bottle changing size, no day turning into night. (3) Falling behind - drop in a hit reference video and we extract hook, conflict and twist, then rewrite the structure for your product. (4) Two platforms in one go - landscape and portrait are re-composed separately, not cropped. 5. Narrative shorts: one episode, under 2 minutes, told through ACTION AND OBJECTS — a hand setting a cup down, a worn shoe sole, a jacket on an empty chair; these stick better than faces (that is how we shot our own shorts). Dialogue is welcome: lines stay lines, not narration - the person speaks on camera, and voice, expression and action line up shot by shot, verifiable frame by frame. Each shot carries one action and one camera move; no flicker, no padding with slow motion. Technically, people appear as wardrobe, hands and back views, with no close-up faces: this sidesteps cross-shot face drift and portrait rights. One face acting to camera throughout: we take single-episode trials with shot-by-shot acceptance (no guaranteed results); no 20-episode series with one recurring lead and no cross-episode face locking; each episode is a full build, priced per episode. 6. Footage rescue: clip already generated but has garbled text, continuity breaks or mismatched blocking? Repair before re-generating — one regenerated shot costs about 50-90 credits, a frame-by-frame repair costs zero; we fix what can be fixed and redo what must be, quoted after review.
[Straight talk] We do not claim cinema-grade films, we do not take scripts longer than 3 minutes, we do not take a 20-episode series with one recurring lead, and 'one face acting throughout' is single-episode trials with shot-by-shot acceptance only. What we deliver: review-safe, continuity-safe, same-day. Measured editing time 3.7-8.3 minutes.
displayDescription.zh:
像剧组拍的，不像开盲盒抽的。
专治 AI 剪片 4 个致命伤，外加 2 件别人不接的活：
1. 防限流：自带 117 个广告法极限词库，先钉死「最」「第一」「治愈」，再抓「无据吹牛」（如「0 酒精」「能顶 3-7 天」），拦在上线前。
2. 防穿帮：四维锁定——人物长相、产品道具、场景光影、全局色调。拒绝一集换一张脸、瓶子忽大忽小、窗外白天变黑夜。
3. 防落伍：丢一条爆款参考片，自动拆「钩子-冲突-反转」，照结构重写你的文案。
4. 一次做对两个平台：横竖双画幅各自重构图，不是暴力裁切。
5. 叙事片：单集、2 分钟以内，用动作和物件讲故事——一只手把茶杯放下、一双鞋底磨偏、一件挂在空椅子上的外套，这些比脸更让人记住（我们自己的短剧就是这么拍的）。
   有台词也做：台词不压成旁白——人物在镜头里说话，声音、表情、动作三样对得上，逐镜可以指给你看对不对。
   每个镜头只走一个动作、一种运镜，画面不抖不闪、不靠慢镜头凑时长。
   技术上：人物以衣服、手、背影呈现，不做正脸特写，既避开跨镜换脸，也避开真人肖像权。
   「一张脸对着镜头演到底」可接单集试制、逐镜验收（不承诺稳定效果）；20 集同一个主角和跨集同脸不接；每集全量制作、按集计价。
6. 救片：片子已生成但有乱码、穿帮、动作接不上？先修再谈重做——重生成一镜约 50~90 积分，逐帧修片 0 积分；能修的修、该重做的重做，看片后报价。
【坦白局】
不吹「院线级大电影」，不接 3 分钟以上长篇，不接「20 集同一个主角」；「一张脸演到底」只做单集试制、逐镜验收。
主打：安全过审、多镜头不穿帮、当天交付。
品牌片实测加工 3.7~8.3 分钟；叙事片另算，一集半天起。能做与不能做，开工前说清，不让你花冤枉钱。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a batch of product footage — cut me a review-safe promo video, in both landscape and portrait.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一批产品实拍素材，帮我剪一支能过审的招商短片，横版和竖版都要。

quickPrompts.en: I have a batch of product footage — cut me a review-safe promo video, in both landscape and portrait.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一批产品实拍素材，帮我剪一支能过审的招商短片，横版和竖版都要。

quickPrompts.en: Frame-by-frame check this video for AI-generated faces, advertising law violations and burned-in subtitle typos, and give me an evidence-grade report.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我逐帧检查这条片子：AI 生成面孔、广告法极限词、烧录字幕错字，出一份可复核的取证报告。

quickPrompts.en: Write a 45-second storyboard script for this product's brand short video, with duration and speech-rate assertions.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这款产品写一条 45 秒品牌短视频的分镜脚本，含时长与语速断言。
